planted_paw_slip.rule: a paw flagged planted does not move between frames

knees_and_elbows_bend_toward_pole.rule: fore elbows bend back, hind stifles forward (sign of bend vs pole)

reach_residual.note: frames over tolerance on a swinging leg: the swing target is out of reach and the paw is carried on the leg end (drawn attached); frames over on a planted leg are real failures

door_moves_after_contact.rule: door angle constant (settled) until the hand contact, then held by static friction; see contacts.json
